title: Build an AI Video Studio with Claude Code and Remotion: Setup and Your First Skill
description: Step-by-step: install the tools, set up a Remotion project, and build a complete Claude Code skill that turns a one-line idea into a rendered vertical MP4 — the foundation for a full AI video studio.

headings.text: Step 4: Install Remotion's official agent skills
Step 6: How a Claude Code skill works
Step 7: Build your first skill — hello-video

code.head:
# FFmpeg, plus uv (a fast Python package manager, needed in Part 4)
brew install ffmpeg uv

# pnpm, if you don't have it
npm install -g pnpm

mkdir video-studio && cd video-studio
git init
mkdir -p .claude/skills content/_assets out remotion/src

Copy

video-studio/
├── .claude/skills/      ← your skills, one folder each
├── content/             ← one folder per video: scripts, footage, intermediate files
│   └── _assets/         ← shared music, sound effects, voice samples
├── out/                 ← finished MP4s
├── remotion/            ← the Remotion project (React components that render video)

# .gitignore
node_modules/
.DS_Store
out/
remotion/.remotion/

cd remotion && pnpm install && cd ..

Copy

npx skills add remotion-dev/skills

Copy

# Video studio

Vertical 9:16 videos (1080×1920, 30 fps) built with Claude Code skills + Remotion.

## Rules
- Use pnpm, never npm/npx, inside remotion/.

name: hello-video
description: Turn a short idea into a 9:16 text-animation video. Writes content/<date>-<time>-<slug>/hello.json, validates it, and renders out/<dir>.mp4 with Remotion. Use when the user says "make a hello video", "turn this into a quick text video", or wants to test the video pipeline.
